fields.rendered_full_field: Ah, another <race> comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.
